title: AttributeCardExtension
description: Provides 80+ random attribute upgrade cards to choose !!!
body:
# 🃏 AttributeCardExtension
An expansion mod for CardEngine that adds a collection of 80+ custom attribute upgrade cards, inspired by League of Legends RPG mechanics.

_⚠️ Requirement: Requires CardEngine as a dependency to run._

## ⚡ Key Features
### 🔹 13 Custom Stats
The mod introduces a wide range of attributes to build your character:

Offense: Attack Damage (AD), Ability Power (AP), Attack Speed (AS), Critical Strike Chance, Ability Haste.

Defense: Max Health, Armor, Magic Resist (MR), HP Regen.

Sustain & Utility: Life Steal, Omnivamp, Movement Speed (MS), Bonus XP.

### 🔹 6 Tiered Rarities
Cards scale dynamically with increasing value bonuses across 6 rarity levels: Common ➔ Uncommon ➔ Rare ➔ Epic ➔ Legendary ➔ Mythic

### 🔹 Integrated RPG Scaling
Level Up: Earn vanilla XP to level up your Card Engine.

Draft System: Pick from 3 random cards on each level-up to power up your stats.

Stat Overlay: Press the [ L ] key anytime to open a scrollable menu and view your active bonuses.
